title: Architect agent output
description: Structured design emitted by the Architect agent given a natural-language feature spec for a new aiSlang resource block.  v0.4 replaces the v0.3 5-section markdown (## Block name / ## Purpose / ## Fields / ## Grammar example / ## LANGUAGE-SPEC §4.<N> snippet / ## Decision implications) with this JSON shape via tool-call structured-output mode.

block_name.description: The aiSlang keyword for the new block (e.g. `dataset`).  snake_case ASCII; same convention as every existing block in `aislang-core::ast`.

purpose.description: 1-3 sentences naming what problem the block solves + when an .ais author would reach for it.  Goes verbatim into the AST struct docstring downstream.

grammar_example.description: Sample .ais source showing the block in use.  Plain HCL-style, no fences, no language tags.

language_spec_snippet.description: Paragraph + Type? field table that would land verbatim as LANGUAGE-SPEC §4.<N>.  Use the literal `§4.<N>` placeholder; the human maintainer assigns the actual section number.

new_refkind.description: Name of the new `RefKind::X` variant if other blocks reference this one; `null` if no cross-block ref needed.

checker_invariants.description: One bullet per checker invariant beyond the universal duplicate-label rejection.  Empty array if duplicate-label is the only check.

decision_conflicts.description: Explicit per-decision conflict + stance.  Empty when the design satisfies every locked decision.

byte_stable_v0_2_roundtrip.description: True iff projects that don't use this new block produce byte-identical serialised AST under v0.4 as they did under v0.2.  Required for Decision 44.4 compliance.

type.description: Closed type set from `aislang-core::types`.  See knowledge corpus 01_ast_struct_conventions.md for the exact mapping.

required.description: Required field → accumulator is `Option<T>` + `.ok_or_else()` in constructor.  Optional → accumulator uses `T::default()`.

range_min.description: Inclusive lower bound for Duration/Int fields (`"1s"`, `"256"`).  `null` when no range constraint.

enum_type.description: Rust enum type name when `type` = `Enum`.  Null otherwise.

enum_variants.description: Closed-enum variant names when `type` = `Enum`.  Null otherwise.
